contexts.definition: Fields required before work is executable from Ready.
Fields required for work represented as actively executing.
Fields required when work is paused or deferred.
Fields required for finding and risk records.
Fields required for finding and assumption records.
Fields required once authoritative governed change identity exists.

fields.name: Status
fields.definition: Operational Work lifecycle status.
fields.population: Set by explicit Work lifecycle operations.

fields.name: Record Type
fields.definition: Purpose classification of the Work record.
fields.population: Set during intake/triage and changed only by explicit Work authority.

fields.name: Priority
fields.definition: Relative scheduling importance.
fields.population: Set by Work Management and consumed by selection ranking.

fields.name: Effort
fields.definition: Relative implementation or coordination effort.
fields.population: Set by Work Management and consumed by selection ranking.

fields.name: Delivery Stage
fields.definition: Evidence-derived governed delivery stage.
fields.population: Projected from repository/GitHub delivery evidence.

fields.name: Execution Owner
fields.definition: Stable identity of the current execution claimant.
fields.population: Set and cleared only by claim/release lifecycle operations.

fields.name: Blocked By
fields.definition: Provider-observed dependency or blocker reference; explicit empty differs from unavailable evidence.
fields.population: Read from GitHub Project dependency evidence.

fields.name: Documentation Impact
fields.definition: Expected or completed documentation impact for the work/change.
fields.population: Starts as Work command data and becomes governed change evidence.

fields.name: Complexity
fields.definition: Repository change-governance complexity projected into Work.
fields.population: Projected from authoritative schema-v4 governed change scope.

fields.name: Risk Triggers
fields.definition: Comma-separated repository change-governance risk-trigger tokens.
fields.population: Projected from authoritative governed change scope.

fields.name: Project ID
fields.definition: Stable KIS project registry identity for the work item.
fields.population: Derived from the registered repository-to-project mapping.

fields.name: Repository
fields.definition: GitHub repository identity of the source item.
fields.population: Read from the GitHub source item/provider binding.

fields.name: Module
fields.definition: Optional bounded module or subsystem context for the work.
fields.population: Set by Work and handed to governed change planning when applicable.

fields.name: Change ID
fields.definition: Canonical governed repository change ID once one exists.
fields.population: Projected from authoritative local change scope.

fields.name: Origin
fields.definition: Context that originated the record.
fields.population: Set when the Work record is created or classified.

fields.name: Disposition
fields.definition: Explicit decision disposition for records that use disposition semantics.
fields.population: Set by explicit Work decision/review operations.

fields.name: Verification
fields.definition: Repository/source verification state; never live-runtime commissioning state.
fields.population: Projected from provider-native or governed verification evidence.

fields.name: Severity
fields.definition: Relative material impact for finding/risk records.
fields.population: Set when a finding or risk is classified.

fields.name: Confidence
fields.definition: Evidence confidence for finding/assumption records.
fields.population: Set from the evidence quality supporting the record.

fields.name: Review Trigger
fields.definition: Condition or date/event trigger for reconsidering paused work.
fields.population: Required when work enters On Hold or Deferred.

fields.name: Target Date
fields.definition: Optional target date for planned work or reconsideration.
fields.population: Set explicitly by Work Management.

fields.name: Iteration
fields.definition: Optional provider iteration assignment.
fields.population: Set explicitly by Work Management.

fields.name: Source Review
fields.definition: Reference to the review source that produced or governs the record.
fields.population: Set when review-derived records are captured.

fields.name: Authority Revision
fields.definition: Revision identity of the authority evidence used for the Work record.
fields.population: Projected from Git/provider revision evidence.

fields.name: External Link
fields.definition: Optional bounded external reference associated with the work.
fields.population: Set explicitly by Work Management.

fields.name: Created
fields.definition: Provider-native creation timestamp used as deterministic age evidence.
fields.population: Read from GitHub native item metadata.

fields.name: Live Verification
fields.definition: Post-merge live runtime verification state, distinct from source Verification.
fields.population: Projected by the deterministic commissioning lifecycle under #419.

fields.name: Commissioning Key
fields.definition: Deterministic commissioning identity: the exact obligation key for one required surface, or the deterministic set key for a source merge with multiple required surfaces.
fields.population: Derived by the commissioning classifier/runner under #419; source projection uses a set-<digest24> key when multiple obligations must be aggregated.

fields.name: Live Verification Evidence
fields.definition: Compact reference to durable live-verification evidence or linked commissioning work; never free-form logs.
fields.population: Projected from commissioning evidence under #419.

vocabularies.definition: Operational Work lifecycle status projected to GitHub Project Status.

values.label: Inbox
values.definition: Captured work not yet triaged.

values.label: Triage
values.definition: Work being classified and prepared for a disposition.

values.label: Proposed
values.definition: Work proposed for acceptance but not yet approved.

values.label: Approved
values.definition: Accepted work that is not yet admitted to the executable queue.

values.label: Ready
values.definition: Work admitted for deterministic next-work eligibility subject to readiness, claim, and dependency guards.

values.label: Active
values.definition: Work currently claimed for execution.

values.label: Blocked
values.definition: Work that cannot proceed because a blocking condition is present.

values.label: On Hold
values.definition: Work intentionally paused pending a declared review trigger.

values.label: Deferred
values.definition: Work postponed for later reconsideration with a declared review trigger.

values.label: Rejected
values.definition: Work explicitly not accepted for execution in its current form.

values.label: Superseded
values.definition: Work replaced by a newer authoritative record or outcome.

values.label: Done
values.definition: Work whose required completion and closeout gates are satisfied.

vocabularies.definition: Classification of the purpose of a Work record.

values.label: Idea
values.definition: Uncommitted candidate work requiring triage before it becomes actionable.

values.label: Task
values.definition: A bounded actionable unit of work.

values.label: Specification Slice
values.definition: A bounded specification or delivery slice tracked as work.

values.label: Review Run
values.definition: A record representing one review execution and its evidence.

values.label: Finding
values.definition: An actionable observation produced by review, verification, audit, or commissioning.

values.label: Decision
values.definition: A record of an explicit authoritative choice.

values.label: Assumption
values.definition: A proposition tracked because later evidence may validate or invalidate it.

values.label: Risk
values.definition: A potential adverse condition tracked for mitigation or disposition.

values.label: Approval
values.definition: A record of an explicit approval decision.

values.label: Hold
values.definition: A record whose purpose is to track a pause or hold condition.

values.label: Research
values.definition: A bounded investigation intended to produce evidence or a decision.

values.label: Defect
values.definition: A known incorrect or broken product or system behavior requiring correction.

values.label: Security Finding
values.definition: A finding whose material impact is security-related.

vocabularies.definition: Relative scheduling importance used by the current deterministic Work queue.

values.label: Critical
values.definition: Highest configured scheduling importance.

values.label: High
values.definition: High scheduling importance below Critical.

values.label: Medium
values.definition: Normal scheduling importance below High.

values.label: Low
values.definition: Lowest configured scheduling importance.

vocabularies.definition: Relative implementation or coordination size used by the current deterministic Work queue.

values.label: Tiny
values.definition: Smallest configured relative effort.

values.label: Small
values.definition: Small relative effort.

values.label: Medium
values.definition: Moderate relative effort.

values.label: Large
values.definition: Largest configured relative effort.

vocabularies.definition: Evidence-derived stage of governed repository delivery.

values.label: None
values.definition: No governed delivery stage has been established.

values.label: Change Created
values.definition: A governed repository change has been created.

values.label: Implementing
values.definition: Implementation is in progress.

values.label: PR Open
values.definition: A pull request is open for the governed change.

values.label: Review
values.definition: The governed change is in review.

values.label: CI Pending
values.definition: Provider-native verification is pending.

values.label: CI Failed
values.definition: Provider-native verification failed.

values.label: CI Passed
values.definition: Provider-native verification passed for the applicable head.

values.label: Merged
values.definition: The governed change has been observed merged.

values.label: Documentation
values.definition: Post-merge documentation reconciliation is due or in progress.

values.label: Commissioning
values.definition: Live verification or commissioning is pending or in progress.

values.label: Complete
values.definition: Delivery and required closeout evidence are complete.

vocabularies.definition: Repository documentation impact projected from Work to governed change and back as evidence.

values.label: Not Assessed
values.definition: Documentation impact has not yet been assessed.

values.label: None
values.definition: No documentation change is required, with rationale recorded where required.

values.label: Planned
values.definition: Documentation changes are planned.

values.label: In Progress
values.definition: Documentation changes are being implemented.

values.label: Pre-merge Complete
values.definition: Required pre-merge documentation work is complete.

values.label: Post-merge Complete
values.definition: Required post-merge documentation reconciliation is complete.

vocabularies.definition: Projection of repository change-governance complexity; detailed classification criteria remain owned by change-governance settings.

values.label: Small
values.definition: Repository change-governance Small classification.

values.label: Medium
values.definition: Repository change-governance Medium classification.

values.label: Large
values.definition: Repository change-governance Large classification.

vocabularies.definition: Source context that caused a Work record to be created.

values.label: Operator
values.definition: Created directly from operator intent.

values.label: Review
values.definition: Created from review evidence.

values.label: Verification
values.definition: Created from verification evidence.

values.label: Implementation
values.definition: Created from implementation activity or discovery.

values.label: Research
values.definition: Created from research activity or evidence.

vocabularies.definition: Current decision disposition for records that require an explicit disposition.

values.label: Open
values.definition: No terminal disposition has been selected.

values.label: Accepted
values.definition: The record or proposition is accepted.

values.label: Rejected
values.definition: The record or proposition is rejected.

values.label: Superseded
values.definition: A newer authoritative record replaces this one.

values.label: Mitigated
values.definition: The tracked risk or finding has been mitigated.

values.label: Deferred
values.definition: Disposition is intentionally postponed.

vocabularies.definition: Repository/source verification state; it does not represent post-merge live runtime proof.

values.label: Not Run
values.definition: Repository/source verification has not run.

values.label: Pending
values.definition: Repository/source verification is pending or running.

values.label: Passed
values.definition: Repository/source verification passed for the applicable evidence identity.

values.label: Failed
values.definition: Repository/source verification failed.

values.label: Blocked
values.definition: Repository/source verification cannot currently complete.

vocabularies.definition: Relative material impact of a finding or risk.

values.label: Critical
values.definition: Highest material impact requiring urgent attention.

values.label: High
values.definition: High material impact.

values.label: Medium
values.definition: Moderate material impact.

values.label: Low
values.definition: Limited material impact.

vocabularies.definition: Relative confidence classification for finding and assumption evidence; current Work authority does not define quantitative or qualitative thresholds.

values.label: High
values.definition: Highest configured confidence label; no additional threshold is defined by current Work authority.

values.label: Medium
values.definition: Middle configured confidence label; no additional threshold is defined by current Work authority.

values.label: Low
values.definition: Lowest configured confidence label; no additional threshold is defined by current Work authority.

vocabularies.definition: Post-merge live runtime verification state, distinct from repository/source Verification.

values.label: Not Assessed
values.definition: The need for live verification has not yet been classified.

values.label: Not Required
values.definition: Deterministic classification found no live verification obligation.

values.label: Pending
values.definition: Live verification is required and has not yet completed.

values.label: Passed
values.definition: Required live verification passed against the actual exposed capability or runtime path.

values.label: Failed
values.definition: Required live verification ran and failed its expected invariant.

values.label: Blocked
values.definition: Required live verification cannot currently complete.
